authority: authority-scope.json exact original04 assertions govern. Source-bound selected design, not independent acceptance or new platform deployment.

selectedGuarantee.name: same-service-controlled-writers+observed-baseline
participatingWriters: same Vesta coordinator page manual/Agent/autosave save
headless continuation after real page close/ownership barrier; native Engine emits candidate and publication uses same adapter/per-op gate, no direct primary overwrite bypass (inherited HS3 rule)
selectedGuarantee.serialization: same actual coordinator instance, generation/document/epoch/op guard; no claim over separate process/coordinator
selectedGuarantee.baseline: each operation immutable expected target; final compare cannot borrow updated shared SoftwareFiles baseline
selectedGuarantee.externalObserved: external change detected at final baseline check rejects before overwriting; permissions/quota/readback failures retain draft
selectedGuarantee.residualRace: arbitrary nonparticipating writer can still change between final check and rename or after readback. No globalCAS guarantee and no proof that such intervening bytes survive. Preserve this explicit limitation and future real interleaving case, never report arbitrary-writer atomic protection.

supersedesHS3: Do not require every shell/file API/other coordinator to join a global gate as a blanket design admission precondition. If caller requests stronger globalCAS, reply E_HOST_SCOPE_UNSUPPORTED; never silently label selected guarantee as stronger.

currentHostBinding.designProfile: Linux descriptor-anchored personal-space/dsh volumes under existing account isolation+quota
currentHostBinding.actualVolumeAtImplementation: runtime-derived canonical root/mount/account paths via existing QuotaStorage; historical XFS profile reference only, no current machine mount assumed
currentHostBinding.limitAuthority: QuotaStorage.usage actual kernel limits; metadata and work volumes separate, no new quota service or Sound limits
currentHostBinding.privateStore: HS3 private DSH registry; actual sandbox full+space guards required to use it as original-operation evidence, otherwise explicit expired-unresolved/new-lifecycle recovery

requiredVestaDeltas: register supported primary/export extension in existing adapter
freeze per-op baseline, source/candidate/target identity; current page generations checked at every publication boundary
resources first/main last using existing anchored file writes; add file/parent sync for all newly-created reachable directory edges from existing primitive pattern
HS3 immutable private journal generations/retirement and exact query; no work payload in DSH metadata
independent full persisted03 semantic/resource comparison before captured Saved; no rollback of unknown reachable data
actual native Vesta CLI confinement with no operation-registry grant
admission: At actual implementation derive capability from server context, reject missing permission/quota/anchoring/durable parent sync/private-store scope at affected step; source-bound design does not mint a true deploymentQualified flag. Existing Word/Film/Sketch acceptance never qualifies Vesta itself.
